text:
GENERATE BURST CS-objiso-dress-P — ISOLATE painted scenery from its own scene crops (Matt fallback, R-C3-61/64/68). task_id "CS-objiso-dress-P".

IMAGE 1 (1536×1024) is a sheet on flat PURE GREEN #00ff00 holding enlarged crops of a hand-painted 2D ARPG level at sunset (light from the upper-left): seven tiles: a scorched dead snag with an ember-glowing crack (top-left); two blackened tree stumps; a stack of two wooden crates with a barrel beside them; three rocks. KEEP ONLY those objects (small stones touching a rock are part of it; the ember glow is part of the snag). Remove to flat green: ground, dirt, grass, shrubs, ferns, the stone rim, leaves or branches of other trees that intrude into a tile, and all ground shadows.
Use image_gen in EDIT mode on IMAGE 1 and deliver ONE 1536×1024 image in which every kept object stays EXACTLY as painted — same pixels, same position in the sheet, same size, outline, colours and lighting (including its own shaded sides, moss or grass growing ON it) — and everything else is flat PURE GREEN #00ff00 with a crisp edge against each object (no halo, no glow, no blur, no green inside leaf gaps that were sky/ground — gaps between leaves and branches become green too). Where an object's base met the ground, finish its bottom edge cleanly. Nothing new is added; nothing moves.

One image_gen call. ONE retry only if a kept object moved, was resized or redrawn differently, ground/shadow/removed objects remain, or the green is not flat — name the reason. Copy the output from $CODEX_HOME/generated_images/... to out/objiso_dress_P.png with sha256. No code. No other files. No web.
RETURN: receipt task_id "CS-objiso-dress-P"; images = the file with prompt, references and elapsed_s; calls_used = the TRUE number of image_gen calls; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.
